technical.zh-CN: MEMS 六维力传感器标注直径 9.6mm、高 9mm、重量 3g、SPI 输出；应变式 MX084-30NM 为另一产品，不与 MEMS 参数混用。
technical.en: The MEMS six-axis force sensor reports 9.6mm diameter, 9mm height, 3g and SPI. The strain-gauge MX084-30NM is a separate product and must not inherit MEMS specifications.
